issues.quote: The regulator on the wall had stopped, and his hand was closed on his watch.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no reading, state, or condition for the regulator or the master's watch. Every clock reading it gives is on the kitchen clock, the piano, or the hall clock.
issues.misreading: A solver could take the stopped regulator and the watch in the dead man's hand as a time clue, reading the watch or the stopped regulator as fixing the time of death or of the fall. Neither was supposed to carry a reading, so this invents a clock-based hint.

issues.quote: I went up the back stairs to the atelier, and I called to him, and he did not answer. He was on the floor under the long windows.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the route taken, the room, or where the master was lying.
issues.misreading: The back stairs, the atelier, and the position under the long windows add whereabouts details the sheet does not support. A solver could use them to reason about who could have reached him and when.
